HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MUKESH RAJPUROHIT Order 08/09/2025 1.

The instant petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. (Section 528 of BNSS) has been filed by the petitioner with the following prayer:-
"It is, therefore, most respectfully and humbly prayed that this Criminal Misc.
Petition may kindly be allowed and the investigation in F.I.R. No. 09/2022 lodged at Police Station Rol, District Nagaur for the offence under section 420, 406 & 120B of I.P.C., may kindly be transferred to the other police station / senior police officer and the police authority may kindly be directed to conduct the investigation of the case in a fair and impartial manner."
2.

As per the Final Report annexed with the instant petition, after investigation in the present case,
the Investigating Officer has found offence under Sections 420, 406 and 120-B of IPC made out against the respondent Nos.5 and 6 only and no offence is made out against rest of the private respondents.

3. After arguing for some time, learned counsel for the petitioner prays that the instant criminal misc. petition may be disposed of, however, he seeks liberty for the petitioner to submit a representation to the Superintendent of Police, Nagaur with appropriate directions to decide the same and issue necessary instructions to the concerned Investigating Officer.
4. Learned Public Prosecutor does not have any objection with regard to the same.

Accordingly, the instant criminal misc. petition as well as the stay petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to submit a detailed representation to the Superintendent of Police, Nagaur averring therein all the grounds which have been raised in this petition within a period of 10 days from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

6. In the event, the representation is submitted, the Superintendent of Police, Nagaur is directed to minutely and objectively consider the contents of the same and thereafter, issue necessary instructions to the Investigating Officer.
All the relevant documents with the representation shall also be taken into consideration.
The representation shall be decided within a period of 30 days from the date of receipt of the same.
The petitioner will be at liberty to approach this Court again, if grievance arises.
